title: SOLAR：面向终身学习与持续适应的自优化开放式自主智能体
summary: SOLAR是一种自优化终身自主推理器，通过参数级元学习和多级强化学习，在测试时自主发现适应策略，平衡可塑性与稳定性，在常识、数学、医学、编程、社会和逻辑推理任务上优于强基线。
summary_en: SOLAR is a self-optimizing lifelong autonomous agent that uses parameter-level meta-learning and multi-level reinforcement learning to autonomously discover adaptation strategies at test time, balancing plasticity and stability, outperforming strong baselines on commonsense, math, medical, coding, social, and logical reasoning tasks.
